'''Grant Ekelund''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Denver Grand Slam]] on 1 April 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base asteroids]], according to Clint Hays's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d447">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-03-denvergs-and-equal-opportunity-employersd447/ denvergs-and-equal-opportunity-employers], DeckTech (Clint "GameMaster" Hays, 3 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-03-denvergs-and-equal-opportunity-employersd447/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
